register: The PostgreSQL build the engine runs from
note: QGD-ENG-0004. One pinned build, verified by SHA-256 before it is used. The machine's own PostgreSQL is never used — on a developer's Mac there is usually one on PATH, and an engine that silently ran against it would be a different database from the one that ships. scripts/fetch-postgres.mjs downloads and verifies this; src/engine/binaries.ts refuses anything whose hash does not match.

source.what: Zonky's embedded-postgres binaries, on Maven Central. The only PostgreSQL build published for macOS arm64: EDB publishes osx-binaries for x86-64 and returns 403 for arm64.

absent.why: QGD-ENG-0005. This build carries the server and its two lifecycle tools and nothing else. Backup is therefore a copy of the stopped data directory (QGD-ENG-0011), not a dump.
